queries: WITH acct AS (SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans t GROUP BY t.account_id), reg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(a.avg_amt) AS region_avg FROM acct a JOIN account ac ON ac.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ac.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS overall_avg FROM reg) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg, r.region_avg - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_average, r.region_avg / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_average FROM reg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.region_avg > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: trans.amount is averaged as stored (unsigned), without applying sign by trans.type, since the request says to average trans.amount.
Accounts with no transactions are excluded (no per-account average exists for them).
The 'average across all regions' is the unweighted mean of the regional figures (each region counts once), not the mean over accounts.

assumptions.assumption: Transaction amounts are averaged as stored (unsigned), with no sign adjustment for credit/withdrawal type.
The 'average across all regions' is the unweighted mean of the regional figures (each region counts once), not the mean of all accounts or transactions.
Only accounts with at least one transaction are included; regions are those with at least one such account.

responses.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM trans t GROUP BY t.account_id), reg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(acc.avg_amt) AS region_figure FROM acc JOIN account a ON a.account_id = acc.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg) SELECT reg.region, reg.region_figure, reg.region_figure - overall.overall_avg AS excess_over_avg, reg.region_figure / overall.overall_avg AS ratio_to_avg FROM reg CROSS JOIN overall WHERE reg.region_figure > overall.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: The 'average across all regions' is the unweighted mean of the regional figures (each region counts equally), not the mean over accounts or transactions.
All trans.amount values are averaged as stored (unsigned), regardless of type (PRIJEM/VYDAJ/VYBER); no sign adjustment is applied.
Accounts with no transactions are excluded, since they have no average.
